feeds.title: The Girl on Bloor
feeds.description: Hi I'm Taylor. I'm a fun-loving, 20-something city girl who's been living in downtown Toronto on and off Bloor Street for over six years. My blog aims to help other super busy people like me eat more wholesome, homemade foods on-the-go, and a large part of that is meal prepping.

feeds.title: Closet Cooking
feeds.description: Kevin came to realize that my meals were boring and that he had been eating the same few dishes over and over again for years. It was time for a change! He now spends his free time searching for, creating and trying tasty new recipes in his closet-sized kitchen. Check out his easy-to-make, delicious recipes here.

feeds.title: Real Food for Real Kids
feeds.description: Real Food for Real Kids (RFRK) is a leading healthy catering company for childcare centers, schools, and camps. RFRK proudly serves nutritious meals and snacks to over 30,000 children throughout the Greater Toronto & Hamilton Area every day. Our mission is to enable and inspire a lifetime of healthy eating!

feeds.title: Toronto Food Blog
feeds.description: Hi I'm Ashley Allinson. Toronto Food Blog is my blog for the budget-conscious reader who wants to know what, where and when to eat in Toronto. Toronto Food Blog is for the budget-conscious reader, willing to venture off the beaten path to find the best cheap eats in the Six.

feeds.title: Chocolates & Chai
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Riz. And I like to take photos of food. And I like to cook food. And I like to eat food. Chocolates & Chai is a food blog for comfort food and brunch lovers that looks to international cuisine for inspiration. It's about finding the love, and the narrative behind every meal.

feeds.title: eat. live. travel. write.
feeds.description: Hi I'm Mardi. I'm a full-time French teacher to elementary school aged boys and the author of eat. live. travel. write a blog focusing onmy culinary adventures near and far.

feeds.title: Stenoodie
feeds.description: Hi I'm Karen M. Stenoodie captures my adventures in steno, food, and travel.

feeds.title: Gastro World
feeds.description: Gastro World ranges from restaurant reviews, food products, food events and more, this blog is related to all things food. The focus is on Toronto but there is also content from all over the world (Japan, USA, Europe and more).

feeds.title: Starving Foodie
feeds.description: Hi I'm Linda Matarasso. Follow my food and life adventures around Toronto and beyond as I look for the best food to inspire you to elevate your dining pleasure.

feeds.title: Living Lou
feeds.description: Hi I'm Louisa Clements. I am a passionate foodie. Flavour is my game. I am about Cooking through my twenties with simple, fresh and flavourful recipes.

feeds.title: Mary's Happy Belly
feeds.description: My name is Mary, I am a proud Torontonian and a happy mom of 2 girls. My blog will share what make's my belly happy from home cooked meals made from scratch to delicious eats at culinary events and restaurant visits in Toronto. On the recipe front, you will find many Cantonese dishes, dishes with an Asian flair, as well as techniques on how to make delectable meat and vegetarian dishes.

feeds.title: What Food I Made
feeds.description: Just as the name suggests, food I have made and photos of the ingredients and what the dish looked like when it was finished. This will not be updated regularly, just when I remember to take photos of what the ingredients looked like before I started.

feeds.title: The cookbook store blog
feeds.description: Follow the cookbook store blog to find out their culinary adventures near and far!

feeds.title: Good Food Toronto
feeds.description: Good Food Toronto is your best guide to eating in Toronto. Find Insider news and reviews for discovering Toronto's best restaurants, bars, and nightlife. Recipes, contests, and giveaways too.

feeds.title: Seventh Heaven Event Catering Blog
feeds.description: Seventh Heaven Event Catering provides custom catering solutions for the most individualized large- and small-scale settings in the Greater Toronto Area. We provide Toronto's highest degree of event catering. From weddings to corporate gatherings & family events, our professional staff caters to every detail.

feeds.title: Sincerely, KN
feeds.description: I'm Karen, a blogger based in Toronto who lives for the little adventures in life and food, lots of it.

feeds.title: love thy carrot
feeds.description: Love Thy Carrot is dedicated to all things that are good to eat. Marla Hertzman the author shares with you my love of healthy, fresh cooking.

feeds.title: Momwhoruns
feeds.description: Hi I'm Vicky. I am the author of Mom Who Runs shares information regarding Food, Travel, Activities and Sales in the Toronto Area. I've been sharing information with friends regarding events, sample sales, restaurants, and recipes for years.

feeds.title: GRACE LISA MAY
feeds.description: GRACE LISA MAY is a modern blog for women who are seeking the little pleasures within the hustle and bustle of everyday life. It aims to provides a sense of community and inspiration for women everywhere to live their best life at their own happy pace. Find latest fashion trends, the best skin & make up products, the culinary scene in Toronto, the occasional recipe, travel guides (local and abroad), interior & home decor, overall health & wellness and more on the blog.

feeds.title: Foodie2Luv
feeds.description: I started Foodie2Luv blog two years ago when I realized that I was too broke to eat out. My recipes are super simple and quick to make, and in case you haven't noticed - there's nothing fancy or 'restaurant quality' about my dishes. Besides putting up recipes, I also review restaurants.

feeds.title: The George Street Diner
feeds.description: The George Street Diner is about the Little Red Diner at the Corner of Richmond and George St.

feeds.title: The Toronto Cafe and Food Blog
feeds.description: The Toronto Cafe and Food is a review blog dedicated to cafes, restaurants, and other foodie stuff across Toronto.

feeds.title: CraveTO
feeds.description: CraveTO is Toronto's original food, drink and event blog, they have been to hundreds of restaurants, bars and events. Stay updated on Toronto restaurants, food trucks, beer, cocktails and events.

feeds.title: Edible Toronto
feeds.description: Edible Toronto promotes the abundance of local foods in Toronto, the GTA and the Golden Horseshoe. They celebrate local food culture season by season, community by community. They are the community resource that connects the dots of seasonal, locally grown foods.

feeds.title: Hot for Food
feeds.description: Easy recipes to level up your vegan meals. Lauren Toyota breaking all the misconceptions of what it means to be vegan one drool-worthy recipe at a time.

feeds.title: Travelling Foodie
feeds.description: Travelling Foodie is a Food & Travel Blog featuring where to eat, things to do, where to stay, and events to attend from all over the world, especially in Toronto!

feeds.title: myfoodistry
feeds.description: myFoodistry presents traditional comfort food recipes, cooking and cuisines from all over the World; plus ideas, news, articles, opinions, literary and non-fiction books, films and documentaries about food, cooking, health, and well-being.
